description:
Pacific Scrap is a custom game that combines the core roguelike gameplay loop of the game Pacific Drive into Scrap Mechanic.

[h1]Plan and Prepare[/h1]
Use the Route Planner in your garage to plan out your journey, check for any conditions the junction has and set off when you are ready

[h1]Explore the Zone[/h1]
Loot and scavenge each junction, collect Energy Anchors along the way and be quick before the Zone collapses

[h1]Escape the Zone[/h1]
Open up a Gateway with Energy Anchors to escape back home as fast as possible

[h1]Upgrade and Research[/h1]
Use the energy anchors collected to unlock different crafting recipes that will help you explore the Zone further



Please note that this is currently an alpha version, please report any issues you experience. Multiplayer has not been tested yet.

AI disclosure: This custom game has been vibe coded using Claude AI. For more information look up the documentation in the mod folder.
name: Pacific Scrap
